assets.title: Hollow Firefighting Facepiece Display
assets.description: One original static low-poly firefighting-facepiece visual prop on its own low display plinth. A continuous thick charcoal face frame has an open rear cavity, a broad sculpted red lower nose-and-mouth contour, and a separately editable thick curved fully opaque blue illustrative window. One solid faceted front connector and four solid side attachment ears are seated into the shell. Two thick U-shaped fixed headbands have genuinely open front ends, finite ear connections and empty interiors. No head, mannequin, hidden rear filler, transparent sheet, cylinder, hose or complete breathing system is included. Ten named closed editable meshes and five constant opaque PBR materials. The shell has a finite flat underside seated on the low plinth, whose broad flat bottom meets ground. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, X centreline and ground Z=0 origin with design Y=0 datum. One complete fixed display assembly counts as one prop. No textures, logos, external geometry or animation. Original generic visual design, with no brand, model or existing equipment compatibility claim. The window is intentionally opaque and cannot be seen through. No respiratory, filtration, oxygen supply, airtightness, heat, smoke, chemical or protective performance, field of view, eyesight, wearer fit, ergonomics, structural load, stability, manufacture, real firefighting use or safety certification is claimed. Not real equipment design or use guidance.
